evidence.title: Southwest Airlines says ‘brief’ system outage affected boarding, checked bags

occurrences.checkable_against: Amadeus IT Group corporate records and airline software-service records
occurrences.quote_span: Amadeus IT Group, referenced in the statement, is a provider of travel software utilized by numerous global airlines.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines emailed statement to Nexstar dated 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: “Southwest experienced a brief interruption due to a system outage at our vendor, Amadeus,” a spokesperson for the airline wrote in an emailed statement to Nexstar.
occurrences.speaker: Southwest spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Amadeus incident statement for 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: “Amadeus briefly experienced a technical issue today affecting Southwest Airlines, originating from a third-party technology provider,” the IT company wrote.
occurrences.speaker: Amadeus IT Group
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines public statements and delay reports from 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: Southwest confirmed the news shortly after travelers began to report delays.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Amadeus incident statement for 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: “Amadeus briefly experienced a technical issue today affecting Southwest Airlines, originating from a third-party technology provider,” the IT company wrote. “Our teams took immediate action and worked closely with the provider to restore normal operations. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.”
occurrences.speaker: Amadeus IT Group
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines incident records and vendor outage records for 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: Southwest Airlines experienced a “brief” outage on Friday morning that affected the computer systems used to help check baggage and board flights.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines emailed statement to Nexstar dated 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: We apologize to our Customers for any inconvenience and working to get them to their destinations as quickly as possible,” a spokesperson wrote.
occurrences.speaker: Southwest spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines operational records and emailed statement to Nexstar dated 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: The airline continued to check baggage and board flights manually while full functionality was restored.
occurrences.speaker: Southwest spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines flight-operation records and spokesperson statement from 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: “[Flights were] not halted, just slowed due to manual processes,” a Southwest spokesperson said.
occurrences.speaker: Southwest spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines flight-operation records and spokesperson statement from 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: “[Flights were] not halted, just slowed due to manual processes,” a Southwest spokesperson said.
occurrences.speaker: Southwest spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Travelers' social-media posts and Southwest airport operations records from 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: Travelers claimed on social media that their gate agents were unable to scan their boarding passes, or that workers at the check-in gate were issuing handwritten baggage tickets.
occurrences.speaker: travelers on social media
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: DownDetector Southwest Airlines incident report for 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: Outage-detection platform DownDetector showed that passengers began reporting issues with Southwest shortly before 9 a.m., EDT on Friday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage

occurrences.checkable_against: Southwest Airlines flight-operation records and contemporaneous traveler reports from 2026-10-09
occurrences.quote_span: Others said they were told that all flights had been halted amid the outage, though the airline has disputed that was the case.
occurrences.speaker: travelers
occurrences.subject: Southwest Airlines vendor system outage
